adjudication.rationale: In handleCancelBooking.ts, `bookingCalendarReference` was changed from `.find(...)` to `.filter(...)`, and the code now loops `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`. However, inside that per-reference loop, the recurring “cancel all remaining” branch still builds `promises` from `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...endsWith("_calendar"))` and, for each `updBooking`, does `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))` (single ref). Because this recurring-delete logic is now nested inside the per-reference loop, it will run once per calendar reference, causing repeated deletes against the same set of organizer credentials, and it still only targets the first calendar reference per updated booking, so additional calendar references (e.g., other hosts’ calendar refs) are not deleted.
